criteria.suppression_rule: score < threshold; exact model NOT_FOUND is always withheld
criteria.ranking: Highest missing recall, then answerable F1, answerable EM, answer coverage, then earlier grid entry.
criteria.fallback: Unchanged raw model output when no grid entry passes every validation constraint.
criteria.diagnostic: Best constrained candidate satisfies exact-retention and F1 constraints but may miss the required missing-answer recall; it is not deployed on a failed gate.
